title: tc-output-schema-builder
description:
The shape of a model's structured answer, built as a tree of fields beside a rendered preview of the answer, its
raw JSON and the JSON Schema it makes.

value.description: The output object's fields, in order. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

heading.description: The heading – what the output is for

description.description: A quieter line under the heading

preview.description: What the preview shows: the rendered answer ("output"), its raw JSON ("sample") or the JSON Schema ("schema")

flat.description: Drops the tray and the card, for a builder inside another card

name.description: Submitted with the form: the generated JSON Schema, as JSON

disabled.description: Turns editing off and leaves the schema out of the form; a disabled fieldset does the same

name.description: The key in the output object

required.description: The model must always include it

description.description: What the field means – sent to the model as the schema's description

enum.description: Strings (or a list's string items): the only values allowed; undefined allows any text, [] is a problem

fields.description: An object's fields, or the fields of each item of a list of objects

itemType.description: A list's item type; "string" when unset

OutputFieldType.description: A JSON Schema type a field can have
